title: PureFog
description: A lightweight resource pack that reduces heavy fog to provide clearer visibility and a smoother, more open Minecraft experience.
body:
PureFog is a clean and minimal resource pack designed to reduce heavy fog in Minecraft, offering a clearer and more visually open gameplay experience. By improving visibility across caves, mountains, oceans, and distant terrain, the pack allows players to explore the world with greater clarity and ease.

Built with simplicity and performance in mind, PureFog enhances the overall visual quality without altering the core Minecraft aesthetic. The reduced fog effect creates a smoother and less obstructed view, making navigation, combat, and exploration more comfortable and efficient.

Ideal for survival, PvP, and exploration-focused gameplay, PureFog delivers a lightweight and effective solution for players who prefer a cleaner and more immersive world view. 🌫️✨
